prank_description: Replaced the brass pressure-gauge bezel with an engraved 'Inefficient' dial plate
summary: The 'Inefficient' dial plate prank finally pays off as Hector grabs the baton from Silas in the middle of a Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea.
narrative_prose: Hector braced himself as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear howled across the ferrofluid sea, the howling wind and a vibrating metallic hum deafening his ears. He tasted the bitter tang of static on the tongue and smelled thick, metallic ozone as a sudden, sharp drop in temperature accompanied by stinging sea spray battered his exposed skin, forcing him to DEFEND the delicate instrumentation. Bruising violet and orange skies contrasting with dark, oily waves loomed above as he activated the magnetic grapple to ATTRACT the heavy iron baton before the rising tide could CONSUME it entirely. Grabbing the baton, Hector turned and decisively shoved it into Kaio's waiting grip.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

active_location.macro_silhouette: The reinforced deck overlooking the ferrofluid sea shuddered under the immense pressure of the storm. Pylons strained visibly against the violent, dark waves crashing around them. A single, heavy iron baton served as the critical junction point between the two engineers.
